summary_md: Redesigned ARCA's visual identity — new near-black/bullion-gold 'Diamond' and warm-parchment 'Pearl' palettes, a self-hosted Inter/Space Grotesk/IBM Plex Mono type system (fixing a previously dead font-family declaration), a new SVG logo mark and favicon, restyled lightweight-charts/recharts colors, two new shared UI primitives (Button, Badge), and a token sweep across all 14 pages and feature components with a design-rationale doc tying the gold accent exclusively to ARCA Score/grading-alpha/pr — researched from the venture's brain (semantic), planned as a PRP with 4 validation gate(s) (written), then passed on round 1 of 2 against them plus tests, /review review pass (0 critical) and /qa: Booted app (bun run dev) and QA'd the ARCA brand redesign in-browser across both Diamond (dark) and Pearl (light) themes: login/signup, overview, cards grid, card detail (price chart, technical summary, ARCA score, grading tables), analytics (market index, set momentum heatmap), screener, settings, portfolio creation, add-holding flow, and import page. All redesigned components (Logo, Badge, Button, chart theming, DataPanel, HoldingsTable) rendered correctly with no console errors introduced by this branch. Investigated two things that looked suspicious and ruled them out: (1) a small mark near chart price lines is the mandatory lightweight-charts free-tier TradingView attribution logo, not a bug; (2) a 'duplicate key tx0mjp62h5le' React warning on the Screener/movers views is a pre-existing backend data issue (duplicate card ids in /api/market/movers) unrelated to this diff, which only touched CSS classes in that file. No new bugs found..
